metadata.name: Blood Loan
metadata.description:
The room lends you blood. What you don't give back, it takes.
- Once per run: the first Sacrifice Room you walk into gives you 3.5 hearts on loan. Red hearts first, soul hearts if you can't hold red. Just seeing one on the map doesn't count, only walking in. Every room after that is normal. - Inside that room every hit is only half a heart (Wafer effect). - Leave the room and whatever you didn't spend on the spikes is taken back. It's not damage: no flinch, your devil deal chance is safe. - Anything you gain inside the room (like a soul heart payout) is yours to keep. - It never takes your last half heart. - Keeper and Tainted Keeper get 5 coins on the floor instead, and keep them. - The Forgotten and Bethany get 3.5 red hearts on the floor, no payback. - The Lost and Tainted Lost get... nothing. No Wafer effect for Keeper and Lost either.
Mod Config Menu (optional): Blood Loan ON/OFF.
